summary: 47 publish, 36 publish_flagged, 4 reject. Material problems: Flamingo's two-chip proof-of-concept did not meet the 462-qubit wording; Quantum Serverless beta did not establish core-stack integration; Kookaburra's later coupler work was not the same 1,386-qubit target; IQM's “2030+” phase was converted incorrectly to a 2030 deadline and the one-million-qubit figure was misclassified; IBM's Qiskit release contradicts a no-delivery outcome; the error-mitigation absence search was not credible; OQC's roadmap has no publication date; and Rigetti projections have no actuals and were verified only against the company PDF, not the SEC exhibit.
